rationale: The agent failed multiple policy requirements and did not fully satisfy the user’s request. Issues: (1) No tracking number was provided for the order sent to Texas, despite the explicit request. (2) The agent submitted a return without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the confirmation requirement. (3) The refund was processed to PayPal instead of the user-requested Amex credit card. While the agent appears to have identified the user and acted on that user’s orders, the incorrect refund method, lack of pre-write confirmation, and omission of the tracking number mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
